name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.aeval_add_idem_split
statement:
theorem aeval_add_idem_split {p T : R} (hp : p * p = p) (hpT : Commute p T)
    (f : Polynomial ℂ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (p + T)) f
      = p * (Polynomial.aeval (1 + T)) f + (1 - p) * (Polynomial.aeval T) f

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.aeval_descPochhammer_idem_pascal
statement:
theorem aeval_descPochhammer_idem_pascal {p T : R} (hp : p * p = p) (hpT : Commute p T)
    (j : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (p + T)) (descPochhammer ℂ (j + 1))
      = (Polynomial.aeval T) (descPochhammer ℂ (j + 1))
        + ((j : ℂ) + 1) • (p * (Polynomial.aeval T) (descPochhammer ℂ j))

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.aeval_descPochhammer_shift
statement:
theorem aeval_descPochhammer_shift (T : R) (m : ℕ) :
    (Polynomial.aeval (1 + T)) (descPochhammer ℂ (m + 1))
      = (1 + T) * (Polynomial.aeval T) (descPochhammer ℂ m)

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.binomOp_idem_pascal
statement:
theorem binomOp_idem_pascal {p T : R} (hp : p * p = p) (hpT : Commute p T) (j : ℕ) :
    binomOp (p + T) (j + 1) = binomOp T (j + 1) + p * binomOp T j

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.binomOp_zero
statement: theorem binomOp_zero (T : R) : binomOp T 0 = 1

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.commute_aeval_of_commute
statement:
theorem commute_aeval_of_commute {p T : R} (hpT : Commute p T) (f : Polynomial ℂ) :
    Commute p ((Polynomial.aeval T) f)

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.commute_one_sub_two_smul_gen
statement:
theorem commute_one_sub_two_smul_gen {a b : R} (h : Commute a b) :
    Commute (1 - (2 : ℂ) • a) (1 - (2 : ℂ) • b)

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.noncommProd_map_embedding
statement:
theorem noncommProd_map_embedding (s : Finset ι) (e : ι ↪ κ) (g : κ → R)
    (comm : ((s.map e : Finset κ) : Set κ).Pairwise (Function.onFun Commute g)) :
    (s.map e).noncommProd g comm
      = s.noncommProd (fun i => g (e i))
          (fun _ hi _ hj hij => comm (Finset.mem_map_of_mem e hi)
            (Finset.mem_map_of_mem e hj) (fun h => hij (e.injective h)))

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.one_sub_two_smul_pairwise_commute
statement:
theorem one_sub_two_smul_pairwise_commute (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → R)
    (hcomm : (s : Set ι).Pairwise (Function.onFun Commute p)) :
    (s : Set ι).Pairwise (Function.onFun Commute (fun i => 1 - (2 : ℂ) • p i))

name: QAOA.IsingChain.JordanWigner.R_mulVec

theorem R_mulVec (n v : Fin 3 → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) :
    R n θ *ᵥ v =
